entities.summary:
George Herbert (george-herbert) was a prominent English poet, orator, and priest of the Church of England, widely recognized as one of the foremost British devotional lyricists.

Born in the Welsh Marches, Herbert was raised in an artistic and wealthy family, largely in England. He received a good education that led to his admission to Trinity College, Cambridge, in 1609, where he intended to become a priest but became the University's Public Orator instead.
